items.title: Swiggy Instamart Lays Off 340 Staff Members in Business Reorganisation
items.snippet: Swiggy Instamart is cutting over 340 jobs across its corporate and support divisions as it looks to improve efficiency, accountability and decision-making via a restructuring exercise. Enhanced severance, prolonged health benefits and career transition support will be provided to affected employees.

items.title: SAP Weighs Major Workforce Reduction, With at Least 10,000 Positions at Risk
items.snippet: SAP is apparently mulling a big staff reduction that may impact at least 10,000 workers, or about 9% of its global workforce, as the German software company continues with its AI-first strategy. Labour talks are still to determine what possible cuts could be.

items.title: Urban Company AC Launch: Company Offers Five Years of Zero Repair Costs
items.snippet: Urban Company has stepped into India’s air conditioner industry with its Native Ultra and Ultra Air models, giving five years of zero repair cost. The company wants to tackle typical cooling and maintenance concerns based on its experience with more than 18 million ACs.
